personality_one_liner: Sebuah aplikasi pembelajaran coding dan AI tingkat SMA yang interaktif, penuh warna tonal, dan edukatif dengan gamifikasi mendalam.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets and comfortable vertical rhythm with modular tonal cards

do's: Use tonal containers, layered surfaces, and adaptive contrast
Soft pill filters and expressive rounded navigation

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Email/password authentication with registration and login tabs

states.empty: Empty form fields with clear inline validation
states.error: Banner or alert with readable error message and retry button

screens.layout: Centered clean form with expressive tonal branding and primary CTA anchored above keyboard

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce students to coding and AI learning paths tailored for SMA/SMK
screens.layout: Full-bleed carousel with illustrated scenes, title, descriptive text, and pill pagination dots

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Main dashboard showing daily streak, level/XP, active learning path, and quick access to modules

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for streak card and course modules
states.empty: Welcome banner with CTA to pick first course
states.error: Retry button with network error banner

screens.layout: Scrollable vertical feed with sticky top greeting header, streak widget, course quick-access cards, and AI daily tip card

screens.name: Belajar
screens.purpose: Learning catalog with paths for Python, JavaScript, C++, Java, HTML/CSS, and Artificial Intelligence

states.empty: Empty state illustration with reset search button
states.error: Failed to load modules error card with retry

screens.layout: Filterable category tabs at top with 2-column modular cards for each topic and progress indicator

screens.name: Praktik
screens.purpose: Interactive sandbox, syntax dictionary, syntax comparison, live HTML/CSS playground, and coding challenges

states.error: Execution sandbox timeout or syntax error message

screens.layout: Split tab interface for Sandbox, Syntax Search & Compare, and Live HTML/CSS output preview

screens.name: Progress
screens.purpose: Gamification center showing XP, level, badges, streak counter, achievements, bookmarks, notes, and history

states.empty: No history or bookmarks yet state with start learning CTA

screens.layout: Tabbed telemetry view with top XP level badge, streak card, and categorized list of achievements, bookmarks, and notes

screens.name: Profil
screens.purpose: User profile, settings, AI ethics module access, dark mode toggle, terms/privacy, and account deletion

states.error: Failed to update profile settings error

screens.layout: Vertical settings list grouped by tonal containers with account details, AI ethics quick link, and danger zone for account deletion

hero_onboarding.alt: Coding learning student mobile app UI

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully functioning React Native Expo mobile app for 'SyntaxAI SMA' targeting SMA/SMK students in Indonesian.
Ensure bottom navigation features exactly 5 tabs: HOME, BELAJAR, PRAKTIK, PROGRESS, PROFIL.
Implement robust isolated/sandbox execution for Python, JavaScript, C++, and Java code snippets, and live preview for HTML/CSS.
Include gamification: XP, level, badges, streak, achievements, bookmarks, notes, and history.
Include AI learning and AI ethics modules.
Provide email/password authentication flow with persistence.
Support light/dark mode and ensure all accessibility and touch target standards (>= 44x44pt) are respected.
